What I'm exploring

Research interests

Questions I keep coming back to. When one turns into a finished build, it moves to Projects.

01 · EEGBuilding

Can a headset tell when someone is focused?

Brain signals are tiny and noisy. I want to see how much a real-time pipeline can still read from them.

Next: an EEG hackathon, starting from filtering and band-power features.
02 · AcousticBuilding

How much of a scene can a machine understand from sound?

Sound carries context that cameras miss. I'm pairing audio with other inputs to see what a model can infer.

Now: a personal multimodal project, in progress.
03 · Future of workBuilding

When agents take on real work, where should people stay in the loop?

Pingpin taught me where human checkpoints earn their place. I want to test that on everyday work, not only shops.

Next: a future-of-work hackathon built on AI agents.
